extZaloOa.connection.disconnectFailed: The account may still be connected. Check the state above before trying again.
extZaloOa.connection.sub: One Official Account serves the whole workspace. Nothing here shows a credential: the App Secret and both tokens are held by the installation's custodian and are never displayed.
extZaloOa.connection.title: This installation's Zalo Official Account
extZaloOa.error.api_not_registered: The Zalo app has not enabled the permission group this needs. That is a free setting: open developers.zalo.me, and under Sản phẩm → Official Account enable the OA information, user message, send message and user management groups.
extZaloOa.error.connection_unusable: The connection could not be used. Start the authorization again.
extZaloOa.error.credential_missing: No credential is on deposit for the administrator who authorized this connection. Authorize again.
extZaloOa.error.member_not_permitted: The authorizing administrator's access has changed, so nothing was captured. Review what they may see, or authorize again as somebody else.
extZaloOa.error.package_too_low: This Official Account's package no longer includes the conversation API. Renew or upgrade it at oa.zalo.me — the package and its expiry are shown above.
extZaloOa.error.poll_failed: The last check did not finish. It will be tried again.
extZaloOa.error.provider_answer_unusable: Zalo answered something this connector could not read.
extZaloOa.error.provider_unavailable: Zalo could not be reached. The next check will try again.
extZaloOa.error.refresh_outcome_unknown: Zalo never reported whether the credential was renewed, and a Zalo refresh token can only be used once — so nobody can tell whether it still works. Authorize again.
extZaloOa.error.refresh_rotation_lost: Zalo renewed the credential and the replacement could not be stored. A Zalo refresh token is single-use, so the old one is gone: an administrator has to authorize again.
extZaloOa.error.refresh_token_rejected: Zalo refused to renew the credential. An administrator has to authorize again.
extZaloOa.error.token_rejected: Zalo rejected the credential. An administrator has to authorize again.
extZaloOa.noGrant: You have not been granted access to this connector.
extZaloOa.step1.challenge: Save this code challenge in the developer console first
extZaloOa.step1.failed: The authorization may not have started. Check the state above before trying again.
extZaloOa.step1.permissionUrl: Then have an OA administrator open this and approve
extZaloOa.step1.sub: From developers.zalo.me. The redirect address must match the OA Callback Url saved there exactly. Starting an authorization stops the connection that is running now, until this one is finished.
extZaloOa.step1.title: Step 1 — prepare the authorization
extZaloOa.step2.failed: The account was not connected. The code may have been used already or expired — it lasts ten minutes — or the Official Account's package may be too low. Start again from step 1.
extZaloOa.step2.redirected: The address Zalo sent the administrator to
extZaloOa.step2.sub: After approving, the browser lands on an address carrying the authorization code. Paste that whole address here — the code lasts ten minutes and can only be used once.
extZaloOa.step2.title: Step 2 — finish connecting
extZaloOa.sub: Conversations with this Official Account land on the CRM timeline, and replies go back out as the Official Account.
extZaloOa.title: Zalo Official Account
